families.title: Band power
families.formula: P = integral of the Welch PSD over [f_lo, f_hi] (trapezoid), uV^2
families.explanation: How much signal energy each channel has inside chosen frequency bands.

band_power.title: Band power
band_power.formula: P = integral of the Welch PSD over [f_lo, f_hi] (trapezoid), uV^2
band_power.explanation: How much signal energy each channel has inside chosen frequency bands.

csp.title: CSP (spatial filters)
csp.formula: w = argmax (w' C_a w) / (w' C_b w); feature = log(var(w' x)), fitted on training folds only
csp.explanation: Learned channel mixtures whose variance differs most between classes.

hjorth.title: Hjorth parameters
hjorth.formula: activity = var(x); mobility = sqrt(var(x')/var(x)); complexity = mobility(x')/mobility(x)
hjorth.explanation: Activity, mobility and complexity: variance and how fast the signal changes.

wavelet.title: Wavelet energy
wavelet.formula: E(f) = mean over the window of |CWT_morlet(x)(f, t)|^2 (pywt.cwt, cmor), uV^2
wavelet.explanation: Energy at several frequencies from a complex Morlet wavelet transform.

covariance.title: Covariance (Riemannian)
covariance.formula: C = cov(x) (OAS or SCM, pyriemann Covariances); s = TangentSpace(C) about the training-fold mean
covariance.explanation: How channels vary together, mapped to a flat tangent space for linear classifiers.

time_stats.title: Time-domain statistics
time_stats.formula: variance = mean((x - mean)^2) (ddof=0); RMS = sqrt(mean(x^2)); line length = sum|diff(x)|; kurtosis = excess (Gaussian = 0); Higuchi FD = slope of log L(k) vs log(1/k), k = 1..kmax
time_stats.explanation: Simple numbers per channel: mean, spread, size and shape of the waveform.

window_means.title: Windowed means (ERP-style)
window_means.formula: m_j = mean of x over bin j (bin width w ms); optional baseline: x - mean(x over baseline)
window_means.explanation: Average amplitude in consecutive short time bins of the window.

spectral_features.title: Spectral descriptors
spectral_features.formula: Welch PSD, nperseg = min(round(sfreq), n_samples), 50% overlap; band power = trapezoid integral; relative = band / reference band; entropy = -sum(p log p)/log(n_pos); centroid = sum(f P)/sum(P); peak = argmax P in the reference band; ratio = P_num / (P_den + 1e-12)
spectral_features.note: frequency resolution is limited by the window length
spectral_features.explanation: Shape of the power spectrum: band powers, peak, centroid and entropy.

tf_regions.title: Time-frequency regions
tf_regions.interval: task 0.500 to 2.000 s, 8-12 Hz; baseline -0.500 to 0.000 s (original full epoch)
tf_regions.formula: P(f,t) = |CWT(x_bandpassed_full_epoch)|^2; mean/max/energy over the rectangle; % change = 100 (P_task - P_baseline) / P_baseline
tf_regions.explanation: Power inside a chosen time and frequency rectangle, and its change from baseline.

asymmetry.title: Hemispheric asymmetry
asymmetry.error: Pair FC3/FC4 needs FC3, FC4, which is excluded on Page 3. Include it there or choose another pair.
asymmetry.explanation: Difference in band power between matched left and right channels.

complexity.title: Signal complexity
complexity.formula: line length = sum|diff(x)|; Higuchi FD = slope of log L(k) vs log(1/k), k = 1..kmax
complexity.explanation: How jagged and self-similar the signal is (line length, Higuchi fractal dimension).

autoencoder.title: Learned latent features (advanced)
autoencoder.formula: h = tanh(W1 z + b1), z = standardized decimated trial; x_hat = W2 h + b2; minimize mean (x_hat - z)^2
autoencoder.explanation: A tiny network learns a compressed code of each trial (trained on training folds only).

transform.footnote: display only; evaluation fits on training folds

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- feature code (same as the app)
"""Feature families (Page 5, sections 6 and 6A.1).

Every family is used through the scikit-learn compatible composite in ``composite.py``. Each family
accepts (trials, channels, samples) data held in a shared ``DataBank`` and returns (trials, features).
"""


from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import numpy as np

FAMILY_ORDER = [
    "band_power",
    "csp",
    "hjorth",
    "wavelet",
    "covariance",
    "time_stats",
    "window_means",
    "spectral_features",
    "tf_regions",
    "asymmetry",
    "complexity",
    "autoencoder",
]

CATEGORIES = {
    "time_stats": "Time",
    "window_means": "Time",
    "hjorth": "Time",
    "complexity": "Time",
    "band_power": "Frequency",
    "spectral_features": "Frequency",
    "wavelet": "Time-frequency",
    "tf_regions": "Time-frequency",
    "csp": "Spatial",
    "covariance": "Spatial",
    "asymmetry": "Spatial",
    "autoencoder": "Learned",
}

NAMED_BANDS = {
    "delta": (0.5, 4.0),
    "theta": (4.0, 8.0),
    "alpha": (8.0, 13.0),
    "mu": (8.0, 12.0),
    "beta": (13.0, 30.0),
    "gamma": (30.0, 45.0),
}


class FeatureError(Exception):
    """A family cannot run with the current data or settings (shown as an explanation, never faked)."""


@dataclass
class DataBank:
    """Arrays shared by all families for one settings hash. Never deep-copied by sklearn clone()."""

    Xw: np.ndarray  # cropped, picked, band-passed window (trials, channels, samples), uV
    times_w: np.ndarray
    Xfull: np.ndarray  # full epoch, picked channels, unfiltered (trials, channels, samples), uV
    times_full: np.ndarray
    sfreq: float
    ch_names: list[str]
    band: dict
    baseline: dict | None
    Xbase: np.ndarray | None  # baseline segment, picked, band-passed separately (trials, ch, samples_b)
    preset: dict
    all_ch_names: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    positions: list = field(default_factory=list)
    pairs: list = field(default_factory=list)
    upstream: dict = field(default_factory=dict)  # tfr, tfr_freqs, tfr_times (all channels)
    upstream_ch_idx: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    y: np.ndarray | None = None
    cache: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    fit_log: list = field(default_factory=list)  # (family, train indices) for fold-isolation tests

    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        return self

    @property
    def n(self) -> int:
        return int(self.Xw.shape[0])


class Family:
    id = ""
    title = ""
    explanation = ""
    stateless = True
    formula = ""

    def __init__(self, settings: dict, bank: DataBank):
        self.s = dict(settings or {})
        self.bank = bank

    # Metadata -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def names(self) -> list[str]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def units(self) -> list[str]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def interval(self) -> str:
        b = self.bank
        return f"{b.times_w[0]:.3f} to {b.times_w[-1] + 1 / b.sfreq:.3f} s (Page 2 window)"

    def check(self) -> None:
        """Raise FeatureError with an explanation when the family cannot run."""

    # Computation ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def compute(self, X: np.ndarray, idx: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Stateless per-trial computation on rows idx."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def fit(self, idx: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> Family:
        return self

    def transform(self, idx: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        if self.stateless:
            key = (self.id, repr(sorted(self.s.items())))
            full = self.bank.cache.get(key)
            if full is None:
                full = self.compute(self.bank.Xw, np.arange(self.bank.n))
                self.bank.cache[key] = full
            return full[idx]
        raise NotImplementedError

    def preview(self) -> dict:
        return {}

    def meta(self) -> dict:
        names = self.names()
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "title": self.title,
            "names": names,
            "units": self.units(),
            "count": len(names),
            "interval": self.interval(),
            "formula": self.formula,
            "category": CATEGORIES[self.id],
            "learned": not self.stateless,
        }


def clamp_band(lo: float, hi: float, band: dict, sfreq: float) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
    fmax = min(45.0, 0.9 * sfreq / 2)
    lo2 = max(lo, band["low"], 0.0)
    hi2 = min(hi, band["high"], fmax)
    if hi2 <= lo2:
        return None
    return lo2, hi2


def welch_psd(X: np.ndarray, sfreq: float):
    from scipy.signal import welch

    nper = int(min(round(sfreq), X.shape[-1]))
    return welch(np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64), fs=sfreq, nperseg=nper, noverlap=nper // 2, nfft=2 * nper, axis=-1)


def band_integral(f: np.ndarray, P: np.ndarray, lo: float, hi: float) -> np.ndarray:
    m = (f >= lo - 1e-9) & (f <= hi + 1e-9)
    if m.sum() == 0:
        raise FeatureError(f"No PSD bins between {lo:g} and {hi:g} Hz.")
    if m.sum() == 1:
        df = f[1] - f[0]
        return P[..., m].sum(axis=-1) * df
    return np.trapezoid(P[..., m], f[m], axis=-1)

"""Classic families: band power, CSP, Hjorth, wavelet energy, covariance (Riemannian)."""


import numpy as np



def resolve_bands(spec, bank: DataBank) -> list[dict]:
    """Bands from settings: list of {name, low, high}, the string "stimulus" (SSVEP) or names."""
    if spec == "stimulus":
        sf = bank.preset.get("stimulusFrequencies") or []
        out = []
        for f in sf:
            out.append({"name": f"{f:g} Hz", "low": f - 0.5, "high": f + 0.5})
        for f in sf:
            out.append({"name": f"{2 * f:g} Hz (2f)", "low": 2 * f - 0.5, "high": 2 * f + 0.5})
        return out
    out = []
    for b in spec or []:
        if isinstance(b, str):
            lo, hi = NAMED_BANDS[b]
            out.append({"name": b, "low": lo, "high": hi})
        else:
            out.append({"name": b.get("name") or f"{b['low']:g}-{b['high']:g} Hz", "low": float(b["low"]), "high": float(b["high"])})
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class BandPower(Family):
    id = "band_power"
    title = "Band power"
    explanation = "How much signal energy each channel has inside chosen frequency bands."
    formula = "P = integral of the Welch PSD over [f_lo, f_hi] (trapezoid), uV^2"

    def bands(self) -> list[dict]:
        spec = self.s.get("bands")
        if spec is None:
            spec = (
                self.bank.preset["defaultFeature"]["settings"].get("bands")
                if self.bank.preset["defaultFeature"]["family"] == "band_power"
                else None
            )
        if spec is None:
            spec = [{"name": b["name"], "low": b["low"], "high": b["high"]} for b in self.bank.preset.get("keyBands") or []] or [
                "theta",
                "alpha",
                "beta",
            ]
        return resolve_bands(spec, self.bank)

    def check(self) -> None:
        if not self.bands():
            raise FeatureError("Choose at least one band.")
        fmax = self.bank.sfreq / 2
        for b in self.bands():
            if b["high"] >= fmax:
                raise FeatureError(f"Band {b['name']} reaches Nyquist ({fmax:g} Hz).")

    def names(self) -> list[str]:
        return [f"{ch} {b['name']} power" for ch in self.bank.ch_names for b in self.bands()]

    def units(self) -> list[str]:
        return ["uV^2"] * len(self.names())

    def compute(self, X, idx):
        f, P = welch_psd(X[idx], self.bank.sfreq)
        cols = [band_integral(f, P, b["low"], b["high"]) for b in self.bands()]  # each (n, ch)
        return np.stack(cols, axis=-1).reshape(len(idx), -1)  # channel-major, bands inner

    def preview(self) -> dict:
        b = self.bands()[0]
        f, P = welch_psd(self.bank.Xw, self.bank.sfreq)
        lp = np.log10(band_integral(f, P, b["low"], b["high"]).mean(axis=1) + 1e-12)
        lo, hi = float(lp.min()), float(lp.max())
        y = self.bank.y
        levels = [float((lp[y == k].mean() - lo) / (hi - lo + 1e-12)) for k in range(int(y.max()) + 1)]
        return {"kind": "glass", "band": b, "levels": levels}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CSPFamily(Family):
    id = "csp"
    title = "CSP (spatial filters)"
    explanation = "Learned channel mixtures whose variance differs most between classes."
    stateless = False
    formula = "w = argmax (w' C_a w) / (w' C_b w); feature = log(var(w' x)), fitted on training folds only"

    def m(self) -> int:
        m = int(self.s.get("n_components", 4))
        nch = len(self.bank.ch_names)
        m = min(m, nch if nch % 2 == 0 else nch - 1)
        return max(2, m)

    def k(self) -> int:
        return int(self.bank.y.max()) + 1

    def check(self) -> None:
        if len(self.bank.ch_names) < 2:
            raise FeatureError("CSP needs at least two channels.")

    def names(self) -> list[str]:
        m = self.m()
        if self.k() == 2:
            return [f"CSP{j + 1}" for j in range(m)]
        cn = self.bank.preset.get("_class_names") or [str(i) for i in range(self.k())]
        return [f"CSP {cn[c]} vs rest {j + 1}" for c in range(self.k()) for j in range(m)]

    def units(self) -> list[str]:
        return ["log(uV^2)"] * len(self.names())

    def _make(self):
        from mne.decoding import CSP

        reg = "ledoit_wolf" if self.s.get("shrinkage") else None
        return CSP(n_components=self.m(), reg=reg, log=True, component_order="alternate")

    def fit(self, idx, y):
        self.bank.fit_log.append(("csp", np.asarray(idx).copy()))
        X = self.bank.Xw[idx].astype(np.float64)
        yy = np.asarray(y)
        if self.k() == 2:
            self.models = [self._make().fit(X, yy)]
        else:
            self.models = [self._make().fit(X, (yy == c).astype(int)) for c in range(self.k())]
        return self

    def transform(self, idx):
        X = self.bank.Xw[idx].astype(np.float64)
        return np.concatenate([m.transform(X) for m in self.models], axis=1)

    def preview(self) -> dict:
        """Two class covariance ellipses in the plane of the first two channels and the CSP angle."""
        X = self.bank.Xw[:, :2, :].astype(np.float64)
        y = self.bank.y
        a = 0
        Ca = np.mean([np.cov(x) for x in X[y == a]], axis=0)
        Cb = np.mean([np.cov(x) for x in X[y != a]], axis=0)
        from scipy.linalg import eigh

        w, V = eigh(Ca, Ca + Cb)
        v = V[:, -1]
        angle = float(np.arctan2(v[1], v[0]))

        def ell(C):
            ev, evec = np.linalg.eigh(C)
            return {"rx": float(np.sqrt(ev[1])), "ry": float(np.sqrt(ev[0])), "angle": float(np.arctan2(evec[1, 1], evec[0, 1]))}

        s = float(np.sqrt(max(np.linalg.eigvalsh(Ca).max(), np.linalg.eigvalsh(Cb).max())))
        return {
            "kind": "ellipses",
            "channels": self.bank.ch_names[:2],
            "a": ell(Ca / s**2),
            "b": ell(Cb / s**2),
            "cspAngle": angle,
            "labelB": "rest" if int(y.max()) > 1 else None,
            "exploratory": True,
        }


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def hjorth(X: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns (..., 3): activity (uV^2), mobility, complexity. Constant signals give 0 mobility/complexity."""
    dx = np.diff(X, axis=-1)
    ddx = np.diff(dx, axis=-1)
    v0 = X.var(axis=-1)
    v1 = dx.var(axis=-1)
    v2 = ddx.var(axis=-1)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        mob = np.where(v0 > 0, np.sqrt(v1 / v0), 0.0)
        mob_d = np.where(v1 > 0, np.sqrt(v2 / v1), 0.0)
        comp = np.where(mob > 0, mob_d / mob, 0.0)
    return np.stack([v0, mob, comp], axis=-1)


class Hjorth(Family):
    id = "hjorth"
    title = "Hjorth parameters"
    explanation = "Activity, mobility and complexity: variance and how fast the signal changes."
    formula = "activity = var(x); mobility = sqrt(var(x')/var(x)); complexity = mobility(x')/mobility(x)"

    def check(self):
        if self.bank.Xw.shape[-1] < 3:
            raise FeatureError("Hjorth parameters need at least 3 samples.")

    def names(self):
        return [f"{ch} {p}" for ch in self.bank.ch_names for p in ("activity", "mobility", "complexity")]

    def units(self):
        return [u for _ in self.bank.ch_names for u in ("uV^2", "1", "1")]

    def compute(self, X, idx):
        return hjorth(X[idx].astype(np.float64)).reshape(len(idx), -1)

    def preview(self):
        H = hjorth(self.bank.Xw.astype(np.float64)).reshape(-1, 3)
        return {
            "kind": "gauges",
            "labels": ["activity", "mobility", "complexity"],
            "mean": [float(v) for v in H.mean(axis=0)],
            "min": [float(v) for v in H.min(axis=0)],
            "max": [float(v) for v in H.max(axis=0)],
            "log": [True, False, False],
        }


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WAVELETS = {"morlet": "cmor1.5-1.0"}


def wavelet_freqs(rng, n, sfreq):
    lo, hi = float(rng[0]), float(min(rng[1], 0.45 * sfreq))
    return np.geomspace(lo, hi, int(n))


def cwt_power(X: np.ndarray, freqs: np.ndarray, sfreq: float, wavelet: str) -> np.ndarray:
    """|CWT|^2 with PyWavelets (complex Morlet). Returns (..., freqs, samples)."""
    import pywt

    w = WAVELETS.get(wavelet, wavelet)
    scales = pywt.frequency2scale(w, freqs / sfreq)
    coef, _ = pywt.cwt(X, scales, w, sampling_period=1.0 / sfreq, axis=-1)
    # coef: (freqs, ..., samples) -> move freqs next to samples
    coef = np.moveaxis(coef, 0, -2)
    return coef


class Wavelet(Family):
    id = "wavelet"
    title = "Wavelet energy"
    explanation = "Energy at several frequencies from a complex Morlet wavelet transform."
    formula = "E(f) = mean over the window of |CWT_morlet(x)(f, t)|^2 (pywt.cwt, cmor), uV^2"

    def freqs(self):
        rng = self.s.get("range") or self.bank.preset["waveletRange"]
        return wavelet_freqs(rng, int(self.s.get("n_freqs", 8)), self.bank.sfreq)

    def check(self):
        rng = self.s.get("range") or self.bank.preset["waveletRange"]
        if not (0 < rng[0] < rng[1]):
            raise FeatureError("The wavelet frequency range must have low < high.")

    def names(self):
        return [f"{ch} {f:.1f} Hz wavelet energy" for ch in self.bank.ch_names for f in self.freqs()]

    def units(self):
        return ["uV^2"] * len(self.names())

    def compute(self, X, idx):
        c = cwt_power(X[idx].astype(np.float64), self.freqs(), self.bank.sfreq, self.s.get("wavelet", "morlet"))
        e = (np.abs(c) ** 2).mean(axis=-1)  # (n, ch, freqs)
        return e.reshape(len(idx), -1)

    def preview(self):
        X = self.bank.Xw.astype(np.float64)
        sub = X[:: max(1, len(X) // 40)]
        c = cwt_power(sub, self.freqs(), self.bank.sfreq, self.s.get("wavelet", "morlet"))
        p = (np.abs(c) ** 2).mean(axis=(0, 1))  # (freqs, samples)
        step = max(1, p.shape[1] // 40)
        p = p[:, ::step]
        return {"kind": "tfmap", "freqs": [float(f) for f in self.freqs()], "map": np.log10(p + 1e-12).tolist()}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Covariance(Family):
    id = "covariance"
    title = "Covariance (Riemannian)"
    explanation = "How channels vary together, mapped to a flat tangent space for linear classifiers."
    stateless = False
    formula = "C = cov(x) (OAS or SCM, pyriemann Covariances); s = TangentSpace(C) about the training-fold mean"

    def n(self):
        return len(self.bank.ch_names)

    def names(self):
        ch = self.bank.ch_names
        out = []
        for i in range(self.n()):
            for j in range(i, self.n()):
                out.append(f"cov {ch[i]}-{ch[j]}" if not self.s.get("tangent", True) else f"TS {ch[i]}-{ch[j]}")
        return out

    def units(self):
        return ["uV^2" if not self.s.get("tangent", True) else "1"] * len(self.names())

    def _covs(self, idx):
        from pyriemann.estimation import Covariances

        est = self.s.get("estimator", "oas")
        return Covariances(estimator=est).fit_transform(self.bank.Xw[idx].astype(np.float64))

    def fit(self, idx, y):
        self.bank.fit_log.append(("covariance", np.asarray(idx).copy()))
        if self.s.get("tangent", True):
            from pyriemann.tangentspace import TangentSpace

            self.ts = TangentSpace(metric="riemann").fit(self._covs(idx))
        return self

    def transform(self, idx):
        C = self._covs(idx)
        if self.s.get("tangent", True):
            return self.ts.transform(C)
        iu = np.triu_indices(self.n())
        return C[:, iu[0], iu[1]]

    def preview(self):
        k = min(8, self.n())
        C = self._covs(np.arange(self.bank.n))[:, :k, :k].mean(axis=0)
        return {"kind": "matrix", "channels": self.bank.ch_names[:k], "matrix": C.tolist()}

CLASSES = {
    "band_power": BandPower,
}


def make_family(fid, settings, bank):
    return CLASSES[fid](settings, bank)


class CompositeFeatures(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """X is an (n, 1) array of trial indices into the bank."""

    def __init__(self, families: str = "[]", bank: DataBank | None = None):
        self.families = families  # JSON list of [family_id, settings]
        self.bank = bank

    def _instances(self):
        spec = json.loads(self.families)
        return [make_family(fid, s, self.bank) for fid, s in spec]

    def plan(self):
        """Feature names, units, family of each column and the de-duplication mask."""
        fams = self._instances()
        names, units, fam_of, keep = [], [], [], []
        seen = set()
        for f in fams:
            f.check()
            for n, u in zip(f.names(), f.units(), strict=False):
                dup = n in seen
                seen.add(n)
                names.append(n)
                units.append(u)
                fam_of.append(f.id)
                keep.append(not dup)
        return fams, names, units, fam_of, np.array(keep, dtype=bool)

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        idx = np.asarray(X).ravel().astype(int)
        fams, names, units, fam_of, keep = self.plan()
        for f in fams:
            if not f.stateless:
                f.fit(idx, np.asarray(y))
        self.fams_ = fams
        self.keep_ = keep
        self.names_ = [n for n, k in zip(names, keep, strict=False) if k]
        self.units_ = [u for u, k in zip(units, keep, strict=False) if k]
        self.family_of_ = [a for a, k in zip(fam_of, keep, strict=False) if k]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        idx = np.asarray(X).ravel().astype(int)
        blocks = [np.asarray(f.transform(idx), dtype=np.float64).reshape(len(idx), -1) for f in self.fams_]
        F = np.concatenate(blocks, axis=1) if blocks else np.zeros((len(idx), 0))
        return F[:, self.keep_]

    def get_feature_names_out(self, input_features=None):
        return np.array(self.names_, dtype=object)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- transform, selection, classifier
EPS = 1e-12
SEED = 7

class LogPolicy(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """'log': plain log only on columns strictly positive in the fit data; others pass through.
    'signed_log': sign(x) * log1p(|x|) on every column. 'none': identity."""

    def __init__(self, kind: str = "none"):
        self.kind = kind

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
        if self.kind == "log":
            self.mask_ = np.all(X > 0, axis=0)
        else:
            self.mask_ = np.ones(X.shape[1], dtype=bool)
        self.skipped_ = int((~self.mask_).sum()) if self.kind == "log" else 0
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = np.array(X, dtype=np.float64, copy=True)
        if self.kind == "log":
            m = self.mask_
            # Columns that were positive in the fit data; clip test values so log stays finite.
            X[:, m] = np.log(np.clip(X[:, m], 1e-300, None))
        elif self.kind == "signed_log":
            X = np.sign(X) * np.log1p(np.abs(X))
        return X

def make_scaler(kind: str):
    if kind == "zscore":
        return StandardScaler()
    if kind == "robust":
        return RobustScaler()  # median / IQR
    if kind == "minmax":
        return MinMaxScaler()
    return "passthrough"

def fisher_score(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """F = sum_k n_k (mean_k - mean)^2 / (sum_k n_k var_k + eps), population variances."""
    X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
    mu = X.mean(axis=0)
    num = np.zeros(X.shape[1])
    den = np.zeros(X.shape[1])
    for k in np.unique(y):
        Xk = X[y == k]
        nk = len(Xk)
        num += nk * (Xk.mean(axis=0) - mu) ** 2
        den += nk * Xk.var(axis=0)
    return num / (den + EPS)

class VarianceStep(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    def __init__(self, on: bool = False, threshold: float = 0.0):
        self.on = on
        self.threshold = threshold

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
        self.mask_ = X.var(axis=0) > self.threshold if self.on else np.ones(X.shape[1], dtype=bool)
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        return np.asarray(X)[:, self.mask_]

class CorrelationStep(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """Drop a column when |r| with an earlier kept column exceeds the threshold (keep-first)."""

    def __init__(self, on: bool = False, threshold: float = 0.95):
        self.on = on
        self.threshold = threshold

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
        n = X.shape[1]
        mask = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
        if self.on and n > 1:
            with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
                R = np.abs(np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False))
            R = np.nan_to_num(R, nan=0.0)
            for j in range(n):
                if not mask[j]:
                    continue
                later = np.arange(j + 1, n)
                drop = later[(R[j, later] > self.threshold) & mask[later]]
                mask[drop] = False
        self.mask_ = mask
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        return np.asarray(X)[:, self.mask_]

class RankStep(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """Top-K by Fisher score or mutual information (ties broken by column order)."""

    def __init__(self, on: bool = False, method: str = "fisher", top_k: int = 20):
        self.on = on
        self.method = method
        self.top_k = top_k

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
        n = X.shape[1]
        if not self.on:
            self.mask_ = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
            self.scores_ = None
            return self
        if self.method == "mi":
            s = mutual_info_classif(X, y, random_state=SEED)
        else:
            s = fisher_score(X, np.asarray(y))
        self.scores_ = s
        k = int(min(max(1, self.top_k), n))
        order = np.lexsort((np.arange(n), -s))  # descending score, then column order
        mask = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
        mask[order[:k]] = True
        self.mask_ = mask
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        return np.asarray(X)[:, self.mask_]

class ProjectStep(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    def __init__(self, method: str = "none", components: int = 2):
        self.method = method
        self.components = components

    def n_components(self, n_samples: int, n_features: int, n_classes: int) -> int:
        if self.method == "pca":
            return int(max(1, min(self.components, n_samples, n_features)))
        if self.method == "lda":
            return int(max(1, min(self.components, n_classes - 1, n_features)))
        return n_features

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
        k = len(np.unique(y)) if y is not None else 2
        c = self.n_components(X.shape[0], X.shape[1], k)
        if self.method == "pca":
            self.model_ = PCA(n_components=c, random_state=SEED).fit(X)
        elif self.method == "lda":
            self.model_ = LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(n_components=c).fit(X, y)
        else:
            self.model_ = None
        self.c_ = c
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        if self.model_ is None:
            return np.asarray(X)
        return self.model_.transform(np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64))

def selection_steps(s: dict) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
    s = s or {}
    v = s.get("variance") or {}
    c = s.get("correlation") or {}
    r = s.get("ranking") or {}
    p = s.get("projection") or {}
    return [
        ("variance", VarianceStep(bool(v.get("on", False)), float(v.get("threshold", 0.0)))),
        ("correlation", CorrelationStep(bool(c.get("on", False)), float(c.get("threshold", 0.95)))),
        ("ranking", RankStep(bool(r.get("on", False)), r.get("method", "fisher"), int(r.get("topK", 20)))),
        ("projection", ProjectStep(p.get("method", "none"), int(p.get("components", 2)))),
    ]

def make_classifier(name: str):
    if name == "logreg":
        return LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)
    if name == "svm":
        return LinearSVC(max_iter=20000, dual="auto")
    return LinearDiscriminantAnalysis()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load the CSV

def _natural_key(s):
    import re
    return [int(t) if t.isdigit() else t.lower() for t in re.split(r"(\d+)", s)]


def class_order(labels):
    uniq = sorted({str(x) for x in labels})
    try:
        nums = [float(u) for u in uniq]
        return [u for _, u in sorted(zip(nums, uniq))]
    except ValueError:
        return sorted(uniq, key=_natural_key)


def load_csv(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"label": str, "channel": str})
    df["trial"] = df["trial"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["channel"] = df["channel"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["label"] = df["label"].astype(str).str.strip()
    scols = sorted([c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("s") and c[1:].isdigit()], key=lambda c: int(c[1:]))
    ch_names = list(dict.fromkeys(df["channel"]))
    trials = list(dict.fromkeys(df["trial"]))
    order = class_order(df["label"].unique().tolist())
    X = np.zeros((len(trials), len(ch_names), len(scols)), dtype=np.float64)
    ti = df["trial"].map({t: i for i, t in enumerate(trials)}).values
    ci = df["channel"].map({c: i for i, c in enumerate(ch_names)}).values
    X[ti, ci, :] = df[scols].values.astype(np.float64)
    lab = df.groupby("trial", sort=False)["label"].first()
    y = np.array([order.index(lab[t]) for t in trials], dtype=int)
    return X, y, order, ch_names



def main():
    X, y, class_names, ch_names = load_csv(CSV_PATH)
    info = mne.create_info(ch_names, sfreq, ch_types='eeg')
    # MNE works in volts; the CSV is in microvolts.
    epochs = mne.EpochsArray(X * 1e-6, info, tmin=tmin, baseline=None, verbose=False)
    iir = dict(order=ORDER, ftype='butter', output='sos')
    # Crop the epoch by time (end excluded), pick channels by name, then band-pass (zero-phase IIR).
    ep = epochs.copy().crop(WINDOW[0], WINDOW[1], include_tmax=False).pick(CHANNELS)
    ep.filter(BAND[0], BAND[1], method='iir', iir_params=iir, phase='zero', verbose=False)
    Xw = ep.get_data() * 1e6
    times_w = ep.times
    Xbase = None
    Xfull = epochs.copy().pick(CHANNELS).get_data() * 1e6  # full epoch (tf_regions filters it itself)
    bank = DataBank(
        Xw=Xw, times_w=times_w, Xfull=Xfull, times_full=epochs.times, sfreq=sfreq, ch_names=list(CHANNELS),
        band={'low': BAND[0], 'high': BAND[1], 'order': ORDER},
        baseline={'start': BASELINE[0], 'end': BASELINE[1]} if BASELINE else None,
        Xbase=Xbase, preset=PRESET, all_ch_names=ch_names, pairs=PAIRS, y=y,
    )
    # Feature extraction, transform, scaler, selection and projection are all inside the Pipeline,
    # so every learned step (CSP, covariance reference, autoencoder, scaler, selection, projection)
    # is fitted on the training folds only.
    pipe = Pipeline([
        ('features', CompositeFeatures(json.dumps(FAMILIES, sort_keys=True), bank)),
        ('log', LogPolicy(TRANSFORM)),
        ('scale', make_scaler(NORMALISE)),
        *selection_steps(SELECTION),
        ('clf', make_classifier(CLASSIFIER)),
    ])
    idx = np.arange(len(y))[:, None]  # the pipeline input is the trial index
    cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=7)
    scores = cross_val_score(pipe, idx, y, cv=cv)
    print('fold accuracies:', np.round(scores, 4))
    print(f'accuracy: {scores.mean():.4f} +- {scores.std():.4f}')


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
